items.title: Wilson "Willie T" Turbinton Interview, 1990-09
items.q: Me and Joe Zawinul became real good friends through the years.

ctx.x: And Zawinul became very interested in the kind of music you were playing. Isn't that true?

Zawinul has recorded. Me and Joe Zawinul became real good friends through the years. With as much admiration as I had for Joe's playing, he would come over to my house. And I can honestly say that I've heard some of the things that I played evolve in his music, whether it was conscious or subconscious. And I guess at this point I don't choose to look at it as a negative. At the time that it was happening that day, because I certainly wanted to be recognized for a lot of things that we did. I mean, when you go…

Do you remember a little bit about the social and political times that the workshop existed in? I mean, that was a time of the drugs and peace and love, and yet at the same time the civil rights movement and the riots and the black nationalism movement and, you know, the flower children and the hippie world. It was a real interesting time.
